What is the safest way to store a radioactive source?
A
in a lead-lined box in a metal cabinet
B
on a shelf away from other radioactive materials
C
in a glass bottle containing oil
D
in a fume cupboard

options.label: A
options.text: in a lead-lined box in a metal cabinet

options.label: B
options.text: on a shelf away from other radioactive materials

options.label: C
options.text: in a glass bottle containing oil
